summary: Order placement is failing because of order-router. Deploy order-router-00418 ('refactor order validation') went out at 13:09, and from 13:10:07 place_order throws an unhandled KeyError 'limit_price'. The order-router err_rate is 0.304 at last reading (max 0.305). The other deploys that morning (auth-kyc, msg-delivery, llm-gateway) were earlier and their notes describe no behavior change. The likely mechanism is that the refactored validation reads request['limit_price'] without a default, for example on market orders. This is inferred from the error type and has not been confirmed in code. I did not check broker-gateway or postgres, but the exception is raised inside order-router's own place_order, so they look like unaffected callees.

hypotheses.statement: Deploy order-router-00418 introduced a regression in order validation: place_order reads 'limit_price' without a default and raises KeyError for requests that lack it.
hypotheses.label: medium

supporting.text: order-router deploy 'refactor order validation' landed at 13:09, one minute before the first error
First logged error in the window is an unhandled KeyError in place_order
The same error repeats continuously (150 matches, output truncated at 30), so it is a systematic failure
order-router error rate is about 30% at last reading (baseline min 0.003) while latency and throughput are flat, consistent with a code-path exception rather than a capacity or dependency problem
The refactored validation likely accesses 'limit_price' unconditionally, so orders without that field (e.g. market orders) raise KeyError. Not verified in code.

hypotheses.statement: A downstream dependency (broker-gateway or postgres) is the root cause.
hypotheses.label: low

unresolved: The log output was truncated (150 matches, 30 shown), and I did not pull err_rate points, so the exact onset and the end of the impact window are unconfirmed.
The cause is not verified in code: whether 'limit_price' is missing only for market orders or for other request shapes too.
I did not query broker-gateway, postgres or web-app, so I have not directly excluded a second, independent problem.
The err_rate max of 0.305 is a fraction, so about 30% of order-router requests fail, not all of them. I do not know which requests succeed.

actions.text: Roll back order-router to the build before order-router-00418, or hotfix validation to use .get('limit_price') and only require it for limit orders.
actions.rationale: The deploy is one minute before the first KeyError and the error rate is about 30%. Rolling back is the fastest way to restore order placement.

actions.text: After the rollback, confirm order-router err_rate returns to baseline (about 0.003) and that the KeyError 'limit_price' logs stop.
actions.rationale: This verifies that the deploy was the cause and that the mitigation worked.

actions.text: Add a regression test for place_order covering requests without limit_price (market orders), and add canary or error-rate gating to order-router deploys.
actions.rationale: The unhandled KeyError reached production and affected about 30% of requests before anyone noticed.

actions.text: Identify which order types were rejected between 13:10 and the fix, and notify the affected customers and support.
actions.rationale: Customers hit errors and support has 40+ tickets.
